features: Find the SKUs to review

Manage base prices or one supported geographic market catalog. Country prices and compare-at values must agree for a shared catalog markdown.

faqs: Can I start for free?

Yes. All current StockClearance features are included with no app subscription charge or product-count plan limit. Campaigns support up to 2,048 selected variants; large catalogs require a separate capacity check.
Can I clear selected sizes or colors?
Yes. Choose individual variants or all variants matching your filters. Product tags and collections still apply at product level.
How do staged markdowns work?
Each stage uses the saved original price, with your floor and discount cap. The final stage holds its price; an end date or end action controls restoration.
Can it protect my margin?

Optional minimum gross-margin rules require a verified cost in the selected currency. The calculation excludes tax, shipping, fees, overhead and other discounts, so it does not guarantee final order profitability.
Which market catalogs are supported?

Base prices and supported geographic market catalogs can be managed separately. A catalog supports up to eight market contexts and eight active countries with matching effective prices and compare-at values. Competing catalogs, B2B company-location and retail contexts are blocked. Cross-currency inherited pricing requires Markets and publication read access; shop-currency costs remain unknown in another currency.
What happens when I stop a campaign?

Pause keeps prices and stops future changes. End and restore restores matching saved app-owned originals. End and keep retains verified markdowns and ends progression. Outside edits and uncertain operations require review.
Does it create bundle products?
Curated offers create quantity discounts on 2–5 selected variants. Repeated units of one eligible SKU can qualify. They do not create a new bundle product or require one of every item.
What do campaign outcomes measure?

Outcomes allocate observed order lines to campaign item windows and subtract refunded line quantities. They show coverage gaps and do not prove extra revenue caused by the app or physical returns. Gross-profit calculations require verified costs.
Does it send customer promotions?
Marketing briefs prepare editable draft copy after checking stock and prices. Exports and Flow events do not themselves send customer marketing or buy ads.
What data does StockClearance use?
Product, variant, inventory, price, available cost, market/catalog context, discount and campaign records, and order-line signals support the workflow. See the StockClearance privacy policy section.
How do I stop using StockClearance?

Review and end active campaigns, recover pending operations, and deactivate offers before uninstalling. Free access has no app subscription to cancel. Uninstalling removes the access needed for further price restoration.

faqs: Can I calculate current duties or export results?
No. Current analysis, Exact Duty, simulations, alerts, CSV exports, and price updates are paused while tariff data is reviewed. You can still view historical records and account settings.
What are the current billing options?

The Shopify listing offers Free, Standard at $19 per month, and Pro at $190 per year. The annual option is listed as Pro. Review the features and subscription terms on Shopify before approving a plan.
Does TariffShield offer a paid-plan trial?
The current listing offers a free plan for 10 SKUs and does not advertise a paid-plan free trial.
Will my prices change automatically?
No. Shopify price changes are paused while tariff data is under review. When available, price changes require your approval.
Are these final customs charges?
No current duty or margin calculation is available while tariff data is under review. Historical results are not current customs charges. Verify shipment-specific treatment with a qualified source.
How does Exact Duty differ from margin analysis?

Exact Duty is a read-only workflow limited to narrow U.S. quartz surface product scenarios. Both Exact Duty and multi-market margin calculations are temporarily unavailable while tariff data is reviewed; the service returns no duty number. Unsupported or incomplete cases also return no duty number.
What data does TariffShield use?

The app uses product, variant, inventory, price, available cost, origin, classification, and configuration data, along with saved analysis and price-action records. See the TariffShield section of our privacy policy.

faqs: Is ShelfLife free to use?
Yes. ShelfLife is free to use with unlimited batches and its currently supported features.
Does ShelfLife automatically maintain batch quantities?
Merchants maintain quantities in ShelfLife. Update batch records as inventory moves or is sold so expiry reports and picking guidance reflect your records.
What does FEFO do?
First-expired, first-out guidance helps you identify which batches to pick first by expiry date and location. It is included in Free.
Will it send emails as soon as I install?
ShelfLife expiry alerts and weekly digests are opt-in features included in Free. Configure an alert address and enable the notifications you want.
Can I use ShelfLife during a recall?
Batch, supplier, and traceability records can help you investigate affected stock. Their usefulness depends on the records you maintain; you remain responsible for recall decisions and execution.
What happens to my data when I uninstall?

Uninstall starts cleanup of your batch, settings, alert, session, and measurement records. Limited protected identifiers can remain to prevent delayed work from recreating erased data. Use available cleanup controls for Shopify-hosted copies while the app is still installed; after uninstall it no longer has Shopify Admin access. Our privacy policy explains these boundaries.
